library_preparation_preflight.summary: org.bytedeco:tesseract follows the javacpp-presets split: the base artifact ships no native binaries, so tests need the sibling -platform artifact at runtime (same gap already hit and fixed for org.bytedeco:openblas in this repo). Separately, exercising real OCR calls (Init/SetImage/GetUTF8Text) requires trained-data files that have no Maven artifact and can't be fetched over the network under this repo's offline test policy, so the generated test must bundle a small trained-data resource itself.

deterministic_setup.reason: org.bytedeco:tesseract only contains the Java/JNI glue classes; the native tesseract/leptonica binaries ship in the separate -platform artifact (confirmed via the published POMs on Maven Central), exactly like the existing org.bytedeco:openblas test in this repo already does for the same reason.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: TessBaseAPI.Init(datapath, "eng") needs real trained-data to return 0; the upstream sample (bytedeco/javacpp-presets tesseract/samples/BasicExample.java) calls Init(null, "eng") but that only works because it assumes a system-wide tessdata install, which this harness does not have, and tests here cannot fetch anything from the network to get one (docs/functional-spec/tests.md: 'No network except against a declared, pre-pulled allowed-docker-image with networking disabled'). Bundle a small Apache-2.0-licensed eng.traineddata (e.g. from github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast) as a test resource under src/test/resources/tessdata/eng.traineddata, and pass its absolute resource-directory path as the datapath argument to Init(...) (or set TESSDATA_PREFIX to that directory) instead of passing null. For the image input to SetImage, prefer building a small synthetic PIX in-memory via leptonica (pixCreate + simple fill/draw) rather than bundling a second binary fixture, since OCR accuracy doesn't matter for reachability coverage, only that Init -> SetImage -> Recognize/GetUTF8Text -> iterator APIs actually execute instead of failing at Init.
risks: If the bundled trained-data file is omitted or mis-pathed, Init() fails immediately and the test will only cover TessBaseAPI construction/Init, missing most of the OCR API surface (SetImage, Recognize, GetUTF8Text, result iterators) that this library is actually added for.

Exact JavaCPP-generated method signatures (e.g. Init's parameter types) should be confirmed against the generated classes rather than assumed from the C++ API, since javacpp-presets versions occasionally shift binding signatures.
Local Gradle (pullAllowedDockerImages/checkMetadataFiles/test) and native-image runs remain authoritative — this is advisory input to generation, not a substitute for verification.
